title: Arizona Court Releases DUI Suspect After AI-Assisted Police Report Raises Probable-Cause Questions
summary: An Arizona Department of Public Safety trooper used Truleo AI, a police report-drafting tool, to help prepare a probable-cause statement after arresting a driver near Phoenix. At an initial hearing, a Maricopa County court commissioner said he could not determine how much of the narrative was authored by AI without the officer's original account and ordered the driver released. Charges remained pending; no fabricated facts were established.
